log_enclosure: log(q)=2*sum_{k=0}^{N-1} z^(2k+1)/(2k+1) with one-sided signed remainder: z>0 gives [sum,sum+tail], z<0 gives [sum-tail,sum], tail=2*|z|^(2N+1)/((2N+1)*(1-z^2))

derivative_log_mu_cancellation.explanation: For p=mu*q, log(mu)=log(pA(left))+log(pC(right)). The per-left and per-right sums of mu*t^2*q'' vanish at s=10 by the exact fiber cancellations for a and b, so no log(mu) term remains.
